svg.title: Career, shown as a Flutter widget tree
svg.desc: A Flutter DevTools style inspector of Prapti's career. AtomWallet: activeUsers 10,000+, state Provider (migrated off GetX), featureLeadTime -40%, apiLatency -30% batching + caching, payments UPI · bank withdrawals · fiat, security RSA · Keystore/Keychain · AML. KelestialWallet: hardware NFC card → cold signer, seedPhraseExposed false, connect WalletConnect · DApp browser, backup encrypted · Google Drive, push FCM. DiveWallet: state Bloc, architecture Clean Architecture, features send · receive · token swap, web3 in-app DApp browser. Freelance: clients fintech · business, owns scoping · estimates · architecture, alsoBuilds AI automation · n8n · OpenAI, status available. N8nHackathon2025: result Winner, built VISTA insurance-claims pipeline, plus AI content generation. AIHackathon2026: result Internal Impact Award, built AI newsletter automation, with CRM sync · real-time analytics.
